title: The Enigmatic Antikythera Mechanism Revealed

scenes.text: This ancient artifact from 150 BC baffled scientists for decades.
It’s believed to be the world’s first analog computer.
Over 30 gears were found, indicating advanced engineering.
But its exact purpose remains a mystery!
Follow for a new mystery every day.

description: The Antikythera Mechanism is a marvel of ancient engineering that still holds secrets over two millennia later. Discover why its purpose has eluded experts! #shorts #mystery #history #ancientartifacts #Antikythera #engineering #fyp
